structural_change: HBM-WBK2 10-20 structural successor of hbm_wbk_ql_1019 (ql1 cancelled: mapped native32 FAIL 1,411 drivers >32, max 1,696; 8.5 h synthesis on 5.7M CDC pairs from a one-cycle storage-dependent 32-way cross-FIFO K select). New core ot_hbm_svc_wb_kq2_core: copy + lane->PC crossbar stay in the stream family with a registered head-PC one-hot per lane, per-PC lowest-lane arbiter with FIFO credit, registered one-hot select per (PC, 32-b slice) in kept arrays, mid relay xr; only per-PC streams cross, each in 9 reviewed ot_link_afifo (<=32 b, AW 3, RCOPY 4 kept read-pointer copies); hbm side 32-b-sliced 2-entry K pin skids; kept fill FSM copies per SRAM column (lane l in column l[2:1]: DMA slot s writes only column s/2); reset relays <=16/32 loads per flop. A dual-clock payload SRAM (VMG7-5 spec a) is not admissible: reviewed_gray_fifos requires exactly one Liberty clock pin per macro.
